description_en: Allocates a public connection address for a cluster
description_zh: 为集群申请公网连接地址
name: AllocateClusterPublicConnection

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The cluster ID of an Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The cluster ID of a Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the public connection address.

It must begin with a lowercase letter and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

It must be no more than 30 characters long
parameters.help_zh:
定义公网连接地址的前缀。
以小写字母开头，可包含小写字母、数字和中划线（-）；
长度不超过30个字符
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.

Clickhouse: the wide table engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB for MySQL引擎。
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine
